primary_source_check.title: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring

verified_source_axioms.ii: S is connected and no vertex in V(G) minus S is complete to S.
verified_source_axioms.iii: Y0 = V(G) minus (N(S) union X0 union S).
verified_source_axioms.iv: No vertex in V(G) minus (Y0 union X0) is mixed on an edge of Y0.

primary_source_check.verified_auxiliary_fact: Every vertex in X union Y has a neighbor in S. This is also immediate from axiom (iii), since X and Y are disjoint from S, X0 and Y0.
primary_source_check.use_firewall: Only these definition-level/source-structural facts are imported. No P6-specific normalization or algorithmic theorem is transferred to P7 in this gate.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_DYNAMIC_VERTEX_BASE_CLOSURE_V1

setup.P: A source-valid current final state P=(G,S,X0,X,Y0,Y,f) satisfying source axioms (i)-(iv).
setup.u: u belongs to U=X union Y.
setup.color: c belongs to the exact admissible palette A(u), hence c conflicts with no already fixed neighbor in S union X0.
setup.component_uniformity: u is complete or anticomplete to every connected component of G[Y0].

theorem_bundle.statement: The constructed seeded precoloring is a syntactic normal subcase of P, satisfies source axioms (i)-(iv), and has an extension iff P has an extension with u=c.

normal_subcase: S is contained in S_prime, and u lies in X union Y, so S_prime is contained in S union X union Y0 union Y.
f_prime extends f only by fixing u.
u has an old seed neighbor, so G[S_prime] is connected.
proof.axiom_i: G and X0 are unchanged, so G minus X0 remains connected.
proof.axiom_ii_connected: u has a neighbor in the old connected seed S, hence S_prime is connected.
proof.axiom_ii_no_complete: If a vertex outside S_prime were complete to S_prime, it would be complete to the old S, contradicting old axiom (ii).
axiom_iii: Every old Y0 vertex is anticomplete to S.
Such a vertex is anticomplete to S_prime exactly when it is nonadjacent to u.
Every old vertex outside Y0 union S union X0 already has a neighbor in S by old axiom (iii), so it cannot newly enter Y0_prime.
Therefore Y0_prime=V(G) minus (N(S_prime) union X0_prime union S_prime)=Y0 minus N(u).
proof.whole_component_residual: By dynamic-to-component uniformity, if u has one neighbor in an old connected Y0 component C then u is complete to C; otherwise u is anticomplete to C. Hence Y0_prime is a union of whole old Y0 components.
axiom_iv: Let ab be an edge of Y0_prime. Then ab was already an edge of old Y0.
Every old vertex outside Y0 union X0 is not mixed on ab by old axiom (iv).
The newly seeded vertex u is anticomplete to the retained component containing ab, by definition of retention plus component uniformity.
Any old Y0 vertex that leaves Y0 belongs to a whole removed old component. It is anticomplete to every distinct retained old component, so it is not mixed on ab.
Thus no vertex outside Y0_prime union X0_prime is mixed on an edge of Y0_prime.
proof.extension_equivalence: A precoloring extension of the new state is exactly a precoloring extension of P with the additional requirement phi(u)=c. The graph is unchanged and repartition is metadata.

theorem_bundle.name: FORCED_EQUAL_COLOR_PAIR_BASE_CLOSURE_V1

setup.u_v: u,v belong to U=X union Y.
setup.color: c belongs to A(u) intersect A(v).
setup.component_uniformity: Each of u and v is complete or anticomplete to every connected component of G[Y0].

theorem_bundle.statement: The pair-forced construction is a syntactic normal subcase, satisfies source axioms (i)-(iv), and has an extension iff P has an extension with phi(u)=phi(v)=c.

proof.proper_fixed_pair: Because uv is a nonedge and c is in both exact admissible palettes, fixing both vertices to c is proper relative to each other and to all already fixed vertices.
proof.normal_subcase: Each of u and v has an old seed neighbor, so the enlarged seed is connected and all syntactic normal-subcase containment conditions hold with empty deletion set and unchanged X0.
proof.axiom_ii: Connectedness follows because both new seed vertices attach to old S. No outside vertex can be complete to the enlarged seed without already being complete to old S.
proof.axiom_iii: An old Y0 vertex remains residual exactly when it is adjacent to neither u nor v, so Y0_double_prime=Y0 minus (N(u) union N(v)); no old non-Y0 vertex can enter.
proof.whole_component_residual: A component is retained iff both u and v are anticomplete to it; otherwise at least one is complete to it and the whole component is removed.
proof.axiom_iv: The single-force case analysis applies verbatim with removed components defined by N(u) union N(v). Both newly forced vertices are anticomplete to every retained component.
proof.extension_equivalence: Extensions are exactly extensions of P satisfying phi(u)=phi(v)=c.

theorem_bundle.name: R2_SEQUENTIAL_R1_PREDICATE_IDENTITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For uv a nonedge and c in A(u) intersect A(v), R2_P(u,v,c)=1 iff the one-step forced state P[u<-c] has an extension with v=c.
theorem_bundle.logical_form: R2_P(u,v,c) = R1_P(u,c) AND R1_{P[u<-c]}(v,c), when the second R1 is read purely as an existential predicate on the forced state.
theorem_bundle.firewall: This is not yet an algorithmic reduction. B2B0 proves only base closure of P[u<-c], not that it belongs to the full authoritative final hard class on which an R1 procedure could recursively be invoked.
